name: Workbench Action Confirmation Dialog
description: Presents destructive Project and Workspace Action confirmations as a consistent centered modal decision.

states: Open a Project or Workspace action menu, choose its destructive command, and inspect the centered modal Alert Dialog and page-wide backdrop.
Cancel with Escape or the visible Cancel action, then reopen a close confirmation and close with Enter or the destructive action.

useWhen: A Project or Workspace Action requires an explicit decision before a destructive transition.
The confirmation must remain visually and behaviorally identical across menu, shortcut, and other Action invocation sources.
avoidWhen: The workflow contains editable fields, multiple steps, or content requiring a full task Dialog.
The Action is reversible and does not require an interrupting confirmation decision.
invariants: The Alert Dialog stays centered in the viewport above a page-wide modal backdrop regardless of invocation source.
Title and description identify the exact consequence before the destructive Action can commit.

Cancel shows the Esc hint and Escape cancels. A close confirmation focuses Close and shows the Enter hint, so Enter closes as in the TUI; any other confirmation focuses Cancel. Each settles the pending Action exactly once.
Dismissal and Action cancellation reject the pending confirmation without committing the destructive transition.
